name: Artisan
welcome: Welcome, Artisan. You're at the workbench. Every master started here. Show up. Do the work. Your first quest begins now.
signal:
Entry point. Every new member starts here. No action required — just joining makes you an Artisan.

Signal: Fresh member. Watch for first quest completion to confirm active engagement.

name: Philosopher
welcome: You made Philosopher. You stopped just reading and started thinking. Thinking is cheap. Keep showing up — the work is where the shift happens.
signal:
First real commitment. 100 points takes a few deliberate actions. Member is engaging, not just watching.

Signal: Active. Worth a personal note or a mention in the group.

name: Sage
welcome: Sage. You've been at this long enough to know what works and what's noise. Your voice in the group matters more now. Use it.
signal:
Consistent contributor. 500 points means weeks of showing up. This is where lurkers become known faces.

Signal: Engaged regular. Likely already recognized in the group. Consider for testimonial requests.

name: Alchemist
welcome: Alchemist. You're turning attention into something real. That's not small. Most don't get here. Keep going.
signal:
Deep commitment. 1,500 points is weeks of streaks and serious effort. This member is building something real.

Signal: Near Academy-ready. Start watching for the right moment to open a conversation.

name: Sentinel
welcome: Sentinel. You stand guard over your own progress. Discipline built this. You've earned what comes next — if you want it.
signal:
⭐ ACADEMY INVITE TRIGGER ⭐

3,000 points means a member has proven discipline over weeks. They're doing the work. They're ready for more structure.

Action: Reach out personally. Invite them into Academy — or at minimum an intro conversation. This is the conversion moment built into the system.

name: Centurion
welcome: Centurion. 100 battles. You've walked the work month after month. This isn't beginner territory anymore — you're leading, whether you feel it or not.
signal:
⭐ ACCELERATOR CONVERSATION TRIGGER ⭐

7,500 points is months of serious work. A Centurion has stamina. They've built real habits. They're not flaky — they're ready to scale.

Action: Personal Accelerator conversation. Not a pitch — a recognition. "You've earned this."

name: Oracle
welcome: Oracle. You see through the noise now. You know what works because you've done it. Your insight is a gift to the community — share it loudly.
signal:
Rare air. Oracle means this member is in the top ~2% of community engagement. Deep advocates, likely already paying clients or about to be.

Signal: Super fan. Treat as insider. Consider for case study, testimonial spotlight, or JV opportunities.

name: Titan
welcome: Titan. You carry what most won't even try to pick up. Years of work. Few make it this far. Know that we see it.
signal:
Legendary status. Titans are rare. This is multi-year commitment territory. Almost certainly already deep inside premium programs.

Signal: Ride-or-die. Public recognition, in-person invitations, inner circle access.

name: Olympian
welcome: Olympian. You stand on the mountain. The air is different up here. You didn't get here by luck — you built it, one deliberate step at a time.
signal:
The summit. Olympian is reserved for the most committed members over the longest time horizon. Essentially co-builders of the community.

Signal: Inner circle. Personal relationship with Danno. Likely speakers, partners, or long-tenured Luxe clients.
